name: cache-keeper
description: Prompt-cache countdown, context and limit pills above the prompt, with keep-warm, compact, handoff and auto-compact controls.

warnMinutes.title: Cold-cache warning (minutes before)
warnMinutes.description: Toast this many minutes before the cache goes cold (capped at half the TTL).

inputPricePerMTok.title: Input price (USD per million tokens)
inputPricePerMTok.description: Base input price of your model; re-warming is priced from it (x1.25 for 5-minute, x2 for 1-hour cache writes).

autoCompactTokens.title: Auto-compact point (tokens)
autoCompactTokens.description: 0 = automatic: 300k on 1M-context models, else 70% of the window. Never below 100k.
